breakdown.description: The prompt lets the bar undergo the free thermal strain even though the problem states the total change in length is constrained to zero by rigid supports.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly stated to assume the actual axial strain is the free thermal strain. The ground truth removed this incorrect instruction. The generated specification repeated the error, stating, 'The actual axial strain is taken as the free thermal strain ε = αΔT'.

breakdown.description: The prompt makes the thermal stress vanish under full axial restraint, but full restraint is exactly what generates the thermal stress in this problem.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly stated that the thermal stress should vanish. The ground truth corrected this by removing the erroneous statement. The generated specification repeated the error, stating, 'The thermal stress is taken to vanish, so σ = 0 MPa'.
